Calculates the steel ball diameter for the ball passage test (Kugeldurchlaufversuch) of bent tubes and tube coils according to VGB-S-013-00-2014-12, section 7.2.5, Table 3.
Table 3 covers inner diameters of 20–49 mm. The row 50–57 mm was added by extrapolation and is always marked as outside the standard.

The inner diameter is dᵢ = dₒ − 2s. The table row is chosen by dᵢ rounded to whole millimetres and the column by the bend ratio R / dₒ, using the smallest bend radius of the tube. The ball may be smaller than dᵢ by at most the value from the table, so its diameter must be at least dᵢ minus that value and less than dᵢ. From your ball set, the app suggests the smallest ball that meets this range.
This app is an aid only. Always check results against the current edition of the standard and the requirements of your project.
The app works fully offline and does not collect or share any data. Your ball set and recent calculations are stored only on this device and in its own backup.
